pairs.registryProposal: placeholder-design: RouteChunkSkeleton is a near-textbook React realization of 'code arrival is the same wait' (header-only ghost, CSS-only delay) AND a live instance of its reduced-motion trap - a blanket `animation: none !important` reduced-motion reset silently deletes every animation-delay-based invisibility window.
